entries.title: I Timothy 3:1
segments: This is a faithful saying, "If any man is seeking the office of a minister he is aspiring to a noble task."

entries.title: I Timothy 3:2
segments: The minister should be a man of blameless character; he should be husband of but one wife; he should live a sober, self-restrained, orderly life; he should be hospitable, skilled in teaching;

entries.title: I Timothy 3:3
segments: no drinker or brawler; but forbearing, peaceable, and no money- lover;

entries.title: I Timothy 3:4
segments: he should be a man who rules his own household well, and keeps his children ever under control and thoroughly well behaved.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:5
segments: For if a man does not know how to rule his own household, how shall he take charge of a church of God?

entries.title: I Timothy 3:6
segments: He must not be a recent convert, lest he be blinded with pride, and incur the doom of the devil.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:7
segments: He should also have a good reputation among outsiders, lest he fall into reproach, and into a snare of the devil.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:8
segments: Deacons, likewise, must be serious, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of gain,

entries.title: I Timothy 3:9
segments: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:10
segments: They should first be tested, and after that, if they are found irreproachable, let them serve as deacons.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:11
segments: Deaconesses likewise must be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:12
segments: Let deacons be the husband of but one wife, men who rule their children and their household properly.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:13
segments: For those who have well discharged the duties of a deacon are gaining an honorable position for themselves, as well as much fearless confidence in the faith of Christ Jesus.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:14
segments: Although I am hoping to come to you before long,

entries.title: I Timothy 3:15
segments: I am writing this to you in case I should be detained, to let you see how you ought to behave in the household of God--the Church of the everliving God, the pillar and mainstay of the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:16
segments: Yes! without contradiction, great is the mystery of godliness! He in flesh was manifested, In the Spirit was attested; By the angels was beholden, Among the Gentiles heralded; In the world believed on, And in glory taken up.
